data.description: Experience Luxe Coastal Living in Dubai
data.display_address: Dubai Harbour Residences (Area 1), Dubai Harbour Residences, Dubai Harbour, Dubai
data.long_description:
Step into a world of elegance at Dubai Harbour Residences, a premier waterfront development by H&H Development in the sought-after Dubai Harbour district. This exceptional community features three 8-storey buildings, each offering a refined selection of 1 to 4-bedroom residences crafted for those who value luxury and comfort.

In the vibrant surroundings of Dubai Harbour, residents enjoy access to an array of lifestyle experiences, from cultural attractions to world-class dining. The development provides a range of premium amenities, including sparkling swimming pools, a full-service marina, a fully equipped gym, sophisticated lounge areas, a beauty salon, and a private beach with restaurant options and a yoga studio. Children have a dedicated playground, designed to offer safe and enjoyable play.

Well-connected to Dubai’s major hubs, Dubai Harbour Residences offers unparalleled accessibility. The development is minutes from Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, and with direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road, residents can reach Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport within 30 minutes.

Choose Dubai Harbour Residences for an elevated lifestyle by the sea, where every detail complements a luxurious coastal living experience.
